title: Dev version bumps must change every version string together; Helm appVersion tracks the last released version
answers: how do I bump the MLflow dev version after a release
which files hold the MLflow version number
why is the Helm chart appVersion one patch behind the package version
where is the version duplicated across Python, Java, R, UI and docs
body:
Invariant: the package version is repeated in several files that must move together: mlflow/version.py:VERSION, pyproject.toml and pyproject.release.toml [project] version, libs/skinny and libs/tracing pyproject.toml, mlflow/server/js/src/common/constants.tsx:Version, docs/src/constants.ts:Version, the Java poms (SNAPSHOT form), and mlflow/R/mlflow/DESCRIPTION Version.
The Python/UI/docs strings use the dev form (X.Y.Z.dev0), Java and R use their own forms (X.Y.Z-SNAPSHOT, X.Y.Z), and Helm charts/Chart.yaml appVersion is set to the last released version (X.Y.Z) rather than the next dev version.
The pyproject.release.toml dependencies pin mlflow-skinny and mlflow-tracing to the exact same dev version, so changing one package version without the others breaks the release install.
What breaks if skipped: a partial bump leaves the UI or docs reporting the old version or makes the release wheels depend on a mismatched skinny/tracing version.
Fix pattern: update all listed locations in one change to the next dev version, and set Chart.yaml appVersion to the version just released. The PR description refers to tests/dev/test_update_mlflow_versions.py, which suggests a repo script covers this; verify it before hand-editing.
Constraints: the uv.lock change in this PR touched only the editable mlflow package entry; other locked packages were not changed. The release marker in [tool.mlflow-release] is covered by a separate note and is not a per-patch field.
applies: Version bumps on the main development line and release-branch bumps of this repository; not runtime version checks or feature code that reads the version.
says: The web user interface displays an outdated version number after a new release.
Documentation pages show the previous version instead of the newly released version.
Package installation fails due to mismatched dependency versions across companion libraries.
Helm deployments launch with the incorrect application release version specified in the chart.
Synchronize all displayed version numbers across the application console, documentation, and packages.
search: Development version bumps must synchronize all package and documentation version strings together while setting the Helm chart appVersion to the last released version. The version string moves across mlflow/version.py:VERSION, pyproject.toml, pyproject.release.toml, libs/skinny, libs/tracing, mlflow/server/js/src/common/constants.tsx:Version, docs/src/constants.ts:Version, Java pom.xml files (SNAPSHOT format), and mlflow/R/mlflow/DESCRIPTION, while charts/Chart.yaml tracks the released version. A partial bump leaves the UI and docs showing stale versions or breaks release wheels with mismatched dependencies; the guidance applies to main development and release branch bumps, not runtime version checks.
